jupas.nameEn: Bachelor of Engineering in Mechanical Engineering
jupas.shortDescription: the profession. The program covers a broad range of engineering science knowledge, including thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, solid mechanics, materials technology, dynamics, and control. Students can specialize in areas of their interest, such as aeronautical engineering, biomedical engineering, control and robotics, energy and environment, mechanics and materials, nanotechnology, product design and manufacture, and thermo-fluids. Graduates are prepared to pursue various career paths, including research and development, manufacturing, design, and consulting. They may also choose to pursue further education, such as a master's or doctoral degree, to specialize in a particular area of mechanical engineering. Mechanical engineering is a growing field with excellent career prospects. Graduates can work in industries such as aerospace, automotive, medical, and energy, as well as in emerging fields like nanotechnology, robotics, and renewable energy. The demand for mechanical engineers is high and expected to grow in the coming years. The BEng degree in Mechanical Engineering provides students with hands-on experience in designing and testing mechanical systems. The program emphasizes problem-solving, critical thinking, and teamwork, which are essential skills in the field. Graduates are well-equipped to tackle real-world problems and contribute to the advancement of mechanical engineering.

curriculum.title: Curriculum
content: The BEng in Mechanical Engineering provides a broad foundation in engineering science, including thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, solid mechanics, materials technology, dynamics, and control. Students develop problem-solving, critical thinking, and teamwork skills through hands-on design and testing of mechanical systems.
Foundation courses in mathematics, physics, and introductory engineering principles.
Core mechanical engineering subjects: thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, solid mechanics, materials, dynamics, and control.

Advanced core and elective courses; students can specialize in areas such as aeronautical engineering, biomedical engineering, control and robotics, energy and environment, mechanics and materials, nanotechnology, product design and manufacture, or thermo-fluids.
Capstone design project, further electives, and preparation for professional practice or postgraduate study.
- Hands-on laboratory experience in state-of-the-art facilities
- Industrial Advisory Committee ensures curriculum relevance
- Opportunities for research and final-year projects

tips.title: Ace Sir's Mechanical Engineering Strategy — 9 Actionable Tips
content: Focus on English and Mathematics as they are double-counted in the formula.
- Aim for Level 5 or above in both English and Mathematics.
- Strengthen your problem-solving skills in M1/M2 if available.
Select science or engineering-related electives to demonstrate interest.
- Physics, Chemistry, or Combined Science are highly valued.
- ICT or Design & Technology can also be beneficial.
The interview is a key component of the admission process.
- Practice explaining your motivation for mechanical engineering.
- Be ready to discuss current engineering projects or news.
Other Experiences and Achievements can set you apart.
- Participate in engineering competitions (e.g., robotics, design contests).
- Join relevant clubs or summer programmes.
- Highlight any leadership or community service roles.
Your score = Eng + Math + Best 3 Subjects. Plan your study strategy accordingly.
- Allocate more revision time to English and Mathematics.
- Ensure your best 3 subjects are strong and consistent.
Almost all offers go to Band A applicants.
- Put JS6339 as your first choice if it is your top priority.
- Research the programme thoroughly to justify your preference.
Mechanical Engineering offers many pathways; know your interests.
- Read about aeronautical, biomedical, robotics, energy, and materials streams.
- Attend department seminars or open days to learn more.
Consider related programmes in case your score is below median.
- Look into other engineering disciplines at HKU or other universities.
- Ensure your JUPAS list includes a range of realistic options.
Show awareness of the field during interviews and in your personal statement.
- Follow HKU Mechanical Engineering news and research highlights.
- Understand the role of mechanical engineers in emerging technologies.

curriculum.title: 課程結構
content: 機械工程工學士課程提供廣泛的工程科學知識基礎，包括熱力學、流體力學、固體力學、材料技術、動力學及控制。學生通過動手設計和測試機械系統，培養解決問題、批判性思考和團隊合作的能力。
數學、物理及工程入門基礎課程。
核心機械工程科目：熱力學、流體力學、固體力學、材料、動力學及控制。
高級核心及選修課程；學生可專注於航空工程、生物醫學工程、控制與機器人、能源與環境、力學與材料、納米技術、產品設計與製造或熱流體等領域。
畢業設計項目、進一步選修課程，以及為專業實踐或研究生學習做準備。
- 在頂尖實驗室進行動手實踐
- 行業顧問委員會確保課程與時並進
- 研究及畢業專題項目機會

tips.title: Ace Sir 的機械工程策略 — 9 個實用貼士
content: 專注英文及數學，因為它們在計分公式中佔雙倍比重。
- 目標在英文及數學取得5級或以上。
- 如有修讀M1/M2，加強解難能力。
選修理科或工程相關選修科以展示興趣。
- 物理、化學或組合科學備受重視。
- 資訊及通訊科技或設計與科技亦有幫助。
面試是取錄過程的關鍵部分。
- 練習解釋你對機械工程的動機。
- 準備討論當前的工程項目或新聞。
- 展示團隊合作及溝通技巧。
其他經驗與成就可讓你脫穎而出。
- 參加工程比賽（例如機械人、設計比賽）。
- 加入相關學會或暑期課程。
- 突出任何領導角色或社區服務經驗。
你的分數 = 英文 + 數學 + 最佳3科。相應規劃溫習策略。
- 分配更多時間給英文及數學。
- 確保最佳3科成績穩定且優秀。
幾乎所有取錄均給予Band A申請人。
- 如JS6339是你的首選，請將其放在Band A。
- 深入了解課程內容以證明你的偏好。
機械工程提供多種路徑；了解你的興趣。
- 閱讀關於航空、生物醫學、機器人、能源及材料等方向。
- 參加學系研討會或開放日以了解更多。
如分數低於中位數，考慮相關課程。
- 查看港大或其他大學的其他工程學科。
- 確保你的JUPAS選項包含一系列現實的選擇。
在面試及個人陳述中展示對行業的認識。
- 關注港大機械工程的新聞及研究亮點。
- 了解機械工程師在新興技術中的角色。
